title: ✨CLO/MD LiveSync 2.2.0 is now available!
content:
Dear beloved CLO and Marvelous Designer users,

We've just released a new version of CLO/MD LiveSync on Fab! This update features several improvements, including support for Puckering and additional animation parameters.

For more details, please check out [the release notes](https://support-connect.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/sections/44750766887705-Release-notes). Also, make sure to explore [the new options in the CLO/MD LiveSync Mode](https://support-connect.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45304309404441-Opening-CLO-MD-LiveSync-Mode)!

![d6ee4553f7e14cbfb9dedbebe4cb884b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/c4a0a658e0254d85b9687e11648b22ff/images/d6ee4553f7e14cbfb9dedbebe4cb884bpuckering-clo.jpg)

Best regards,

**Bryan** , on behalf of Unreal Development Team at CLO Virtual Fashion
content_description: This page announces the latest CLO/Marvelous Designer LiveSync update, highlighting new features like Puckering support and enhanced animation options.
